description_en: Queries the names of protected object groups that can be associated with a specific protection template
description_zh: 查询防护模板待生效的防护对象组名称列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-template-valid-groups --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-nwy0000pf0e --defense-scene region_block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseTemplateValidGroups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object group. Use this parameter to filter results by group name
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The protection scenario. For more information, see the valid values for the DefenseScene parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html when DefenseType is set to template
parameters.help_zh: 要查询防护场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461421.html的**DefenseScene**参数，当防护规则类型 DefenseType为template的取值范围
parameters.name: defense_scene

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第 1 页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为20，表示每页包含 20 条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protection template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Groups.description_en: A list of protected object group names

items.description_en: The name of the protected object group

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
